correctness.rationale: Exactly 134 free-face pairs were verified from 434 simplices to a particular 166-simplex eleven-vertex induced complex, then rotated seven ways. The induced complex has an explicit 82-pair acyclic Morse matching with one critical vertex and one critical 3-simplex, giving S^3 and integral H3=Z. Exact F2 boundary ranks in two 14- and 12-vertex obstruction families give (n3,r3,r4)=(105,73,32) and (78,55,23). The seven-index covering lemma forces every noncarrier into a mod-two-acyclic barrier; rationalization forces its ambient integral H3 image to vanish. No unverified infinite inference is used.

value.rationale: The result supplies an exact, geometrically natural vertex-minimal support classification for the fundamental integral H3 class of a classical fourteen-vertex cubic graph. It upgrades an abstract sphere homotopy type to seven explicit inclusion-preserving simple-homotopy models and characterizes all possible carriers using two distinct maximal topological obstructions. This is not a routine face-count or arbitrary restriction.
